tool.name: SGLang
tool.summary: Fast LLM serving and programming engine featuring RadixAttention (KV cache sharing across multi-turn chats) for ultra-low latency inference and structured output.
tool.architecture: RadixAttention tree cache + interpreter-runtime co-design engine.
tool.benchmarks: Up to 5x higher throughput on complex multi-turn chats compared to baseline vLLM.
tool.limitations: Focuses on Linux x86 and NVIDIA CUDA environments.
